subject: Private deployment — preflight environment validation & scheduling
messages:
From: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Linda Park <linda.park@brightmed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-03-20T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Private deployment — preflight environment validation & scheduling

Hi Linda / Sam,

Thanks again for the time last week. We'd like to run a 60-minute preflight environment validation to align on the VPC/network egress requirements, air‑gap key handoff, and the on‑prem host inventory needed for a successful private deployment. Goal is to confirm there are no blockers before we schedule the on‑site install window.

Proposed agenda (60 min):
- Introductions & roles (5m)
- Network egress / firewall rules + jumpbox approach (15m)
- KV/HSM / key handoff for air‑gapped deployment (15m)
- Host inventory & OS/container constraints (10m)
- Next steps: docs, follow-ups, timelines (15m)

Proposed slots (Pacific time):
- Tue Mar 21, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed Mar 22, 08:00–09:00 PT
- Thu Mar 23, 13:00–14:00 PT

Attachments: preflight-checklist.pdf (stub) and a draft network-egress-diagram.png.

Please reply with the slot that works best and any additional attendees (network/security leads). If none of these work, share two alternatives and we'll accommodate.

Thanks,
Ethan Park
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ethan.park@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

--
Redwood Inference — inference that scales.
From: Linda Park <linda.park@brightmed.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sam Turner <sam.turner@brightmed.com>
Date: 2028-03-20T18:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment — preflight environment validation & scheduling

Thanks Ethan — appreciate the clear agenda. Wed Mar 22 at 08:00 PT is tight for our CTO who’s traveling that morning. Could we do Wed Mar 22 at 10:00–11:00 PT instead? That will allow Sam and our lead network engineer (I copied him once we confirm). Also, we need someone from your security team to talk about the HSM integration — can you include a security/PKI engineer?

Linda
Linda Park
Director, Infrastructure — BrightMed Health

Subject: Re: Private deployment — preflight environment validation & scheduling

Hi Linda — Wed Mar 22 at 10:00–11:00 PT works for us. I'll add Karthik (our Security & Compliance lead) to cover the HSM/key ceremony workflow.

A few quick notes so we can make the most of the 60 minutes:
- If you can share a short host inventory (IP ranges, OS versions, whether there’s an internal jumpbox) before the call that will speed the network discussion.
- For air‑gapped installs we'll need to coordinate the key handoff window (physical or encrypted USB). Please confirm any onsite access windows or visitor policies.
- We'll review the attached network-egress-diagram and annotate which ports/protocols are mandatory vs optional.

Attendees from Redwood: Ethan (SE), Marissa (Eng Lead), Karthik Iyer (Security), Tessa (PM), Vivek (Ops).

I'll send an invite for Wed Mar 22, 10:00–11:00 PT and include a short pre‑call checklist.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Linda / team — I can join Wed 10:00 PT to cover HSM integration and the offline key ceremony options. Quick pre‑read: please flag whether you plan to use an HSM (Y/N) and the vendor (e.g., AWS CloudHSM, Thales Luna, on‑prem HSM appliance) and whether you require a sealed USB transfer for air‑gapped environments. If you haven't decided, we'll cover tradeoffs on the call.

Thu Mar 23, 09:00–10:00 PT is fine for Redwood — moved the calendar invite and attached the pre‑call checklist. Invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234efgh

Action items before the call:
- BrightMed: upload host inventory doc and note whether HSM is in use (Linda/Sam).
- BrightMed: confirm visitor access window and whether a physical key handoff is acceptable for the air‑gapped path.
- Redwood: we'll annotate the attached network diagram with required outbound ports and recommended jumpbox configuration.

If anything else comes up, ping the thread. See you Thu.

Thanks,
Marissa
